This Appeal Coming On For Admission This Day,

Coram: Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice P Sree Sudha
 Oral Judgment
Learned counsel for the appellant is absent.
2. Learned counsel for respondent Nos.1 to 3 are present.
NC: 2025:KHC:30728 HC-KAR 3.
Even after listing the matter under the caption for 'Dismissal', he preferred appeal against the award of the Tribunal in MVC.No.6408/2016 dated 06.06.2018.

He is the owner of the vehicle and the Tribunal held that, he is liable to pay the compensation and directed to deposit the amount K. Ravikumar vs Jayamma on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53286835/
2 within two months from the date of the order against which he preferred appeal.
4. This Court vide order dated 31.07.2025, directed to deposit 50% of the compensation.

But so far,
he has not deposited the amount and not even appeared before this Court even after listing the matter under the caption for 'Dismissal'.

It appears that, he is not interested to pursue the litigation,
no purpose is served.
Accordingly, this appeal is dismissed.

SD/-
(P SREE SUDHA) JUDGE SHS K. Ravikumar vs Jayamma on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53286835/
